headerDisplay: Development build: device integration remains incomplete. Use a dedicated Aqua Temp shared account when available. Credentials stay in your local Homebridge configuration; never include them in issue reports.

deviceIds.title: Device IDs (optional)
deviceIds.description: Leave empty to include all discovered devices. Otherwise include only these IDs.

debug.title: Debug diagnostics
debug.description: Write a sanitized JSON diagnostic report to the Homebridge log, at most once every five minutes. After enabling, restart the platform and search the log for “Diagnostic report”.

includeInletTemperatureSensor.title: Include inlet temperature sensor
includeInletTemperatureSensor.description: Add a separate read-only inlet temperature accessory. Restart to apply.

includeOutletTemperatureSensor.title: Include outlet temperature sensor
includeOutletTemperatureSensor.description: Add a separate read-only outlet temperature accessory. Restart to apply.

includeAmbientTemperatureSensor.title: Include ambient temperature sensor
includeAmbientTemperatureSensor.description: Add a separate read-only ambient temperature accessory. Restart to apply.
